issue.title: Repair Artifacts Files PNG detail monkeypatch after pane split
issue.description: Proposed by phase sase-mf.4 and independently reproduced by land agent on current master 3c3909c31: tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_artifacts_files.py::test_artifacts_files_populated_png_snapshot fails before rendering because it monkeypatches files_pane.load_file_detail, removed by c756a7c63 when Files pane detail loading moved to a focused module. Repoint the stale test seam to the owning module and verify the affected PNG snapshot plus Artifacts Files visual coverage. This is unrelated to sase-mf's model-routing work; it is fallout from the concurrent Files pane split.
